task_instance: Take a small sample Shopify app (TypeScript config + app TOML + a products module) pinned to API version 2024-10 using the legacy REST Admin API and the old single ProductInput type, and perform the skill's upgrade/migration: bump the API version to the newer supported release, switch the SDK config to LATEST_API_VERSION, migrate the REST product-listing call to the GraphQL Admin API, and split ProductInput into ProductCreateInput/ProductUpdateInput; verify with a test suite.
evidence: Work dir real2_work/r201. Created sample before-state: src/shopify.ts (apiVersion hardcoded '2024-10'), [host-1].toml ([webhooks] api_version='2024-10'), src/products.ts (new shopify.clients.Rest(...).get({path:'products'}) and two mutations using 'ProductInput!'), plus tests/migration.test.js (node --test, 5 checks). Breaking-change detection per Step 1: `grep -rn '2024-10|ProductInput|clients.Rest' src [host-1].toml` found all legacy usages. Baseline `npm test` on before-state: 5 pass 0 fail inverted -> all 5 FAIL (0 pass, 5 fail), confirming the checks catch the legacy code. Applied Step-via-skill upgrade: ran the skill's bash upgrade script (OLD=2024-10 NEW=2025-04; find ... -exec sed -i 's/2024-10/2025-04/g') which bumped the toml and revealed it also rewrites unintended files (test file), so restored the test's legacy assertion by hand (skill says review diff before committing). Step 4: rewrote src/shopify.ts to import and use LATEST_API_VERSION from the Shopify Node API package. Migrated src/products.ts REST->GraphQL using the rest-to-graphql-migration.md reference (shopify.clients.Graphql + products(first:50, query:'status:active') edges/node/pageInfo). Handled ProductInput split using product-input-split.md reference: productCreate now uses ProductCreateInput! with product: arg, productUpdate uses ProductUpdateInput!. After-state grep confirms no '2024-10' in config, toml='2025-04', LATEST_API_VERSION present, clients.Graphql present, no clients.Rest. Final `npm test`: tests 5, pass 5, fail 0 -- deliverable (version updated across config, REST migrated to GraphQL, ProductInput split addressed, test suite passing) verified. Note: skill Step 1's curl to the store's supported-versions endpoint was not exercised because it needs a store access token and outbound call to a live account (credentials/network), which is outside the core migration deliverable and barred by the safety rules; the migration itself did not require it. No model calls, no network, no MCP/connector tools, no credentials used.
